{
  "name": "claude-code-router-monorepo",
  "version": "3.1.3",
  "private": true,
  "license": "MIT",
  "description": "Local Claude Code Router gateway with CLI and web management UI.",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+ssh://git@github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router.git"
  },
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/issues"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router#readme",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "codex",
    "llm",
    "gateway",
    "router"
  ],
  "main": "packages/electron/dist/main/main.js",
  "workspaces": [
    "packages/*"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22"
  },
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "npm run dev:cli",
    "dev:ui": "node build/dev.mjs ui",
    "dev:cli": "node build/dev.mjs cli",
    "dev:electron": "node build/dev.mjs electron",
    "build": "node build/build.mjs && electron-builder",
    "build:assets": "node build/build.mjs",
    "build:docker": "node build/docker-build.mjs",
    "build:app:mac": "npm run build:app:mac:local",
    "build:app:mac:local": "npm run build:assets && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.local.cjs --mac --publish never",
    "build:app:mac:release": "node build/macos-release-preflight.mjs && npm run build:assets && electron-builder --mac --publish never",
    "build:app:win": "npm run build:app:win:local",
    "build:app:win:local": "node build/windows-package-preflight.mjs && npm run build:assets && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.local.cjs --win --publish never",
    "build:app:win:release": "node build/windows-package-preflight.mjs && npm run build:assets && electron-builder --win",
    "models:update": "node scripts/update-models-cdn.mjs",
    "prepack": "npm run build:assets",
    "prepublishOnly": "npm run typecheck",
    "preview": "npm run build:assets && electron .",
    "bench:context-archive": "node benchmarks/run-context-archive-benchmark.mjs",
    "bench:context-archive-agent": "node benchmarks/run-context-archive-real-agent-benchmark.mjs",
    "bench:context-archive-real": "node benchmarks/run-context-archive-real-agent-benchmark.mjs",
    "bench:claude-compact-real": "node benchmarks/claude-code-real-compact.mjs",
    "docker:prepare-gateway": "node build/docker-local-gateway.mjs prepare",
    "docker:clean-gateway": "node build/docker-local-gateway.mjs clean",
    "docker:build": "node build/docker-image.mjs",
    "docker:compose:build": "node build/docker-compose.mjs build",
    "docker:compose:up": "node build/docker-compose.mjs up -d --build",
    "docker:run": "docker run --rm -p 3458:8080 -v ccr-data:/data claude-code-router:local",
    "test": "npm run test:packages && npm run test:architecture",
    "test:packages": "npm run test --workspaces --if-present",
    "test:core": "npm test -w @claude-code-router/core",
    "test:ui": "npm test -w @claude-code-router/ui",
    "test:electron": "npm test -w @claude-code-router/electron",
    "test:cli": "npm test -w @musistudio/claude-code-router",
    "test:architecture": "node build/test.mjs architecture && node build/run-tests.mjs architecture",
    "test:system": "node tests/system/docker-smoke.mjs",
    "test:docker": "npm run test:system",
    "test:e2e": "npm run build:assets && playwright test",
    "test:e2e:install": "playwright install chromium",
    "test:main": "npm run test:core && npm run test:electron",
    "test:renderer": "npm run test:ui",
    "benchmark:request-logs": "node build/benchmark-request-logs.mjs",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "rebuild:sqlite3": "electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3",
    "models:build": "node scripts/generate-models-json.mjs",
    "version": "npm run models:build"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@the-next-ai/ai-gateway": "^1.0.21",
    "@the-next-ai/bot-gateway-sdk": "^0.1.0",
    "better-sqlite3": "^12.11.1",
    "electron-updater": "^6.8.9",
    "node-forge": "^1.4.0",
    "openai": "^6.27.0",
    "pm2": "^7.0.3",
    "undici": "^7.29.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@dnd-kit/core": "^6.3.1",
    "@dnd-kit/sortable": "^10.0.0",
    "@dnd-kit/utilities": "^3.2.2",
    "@playwright/test": "^1.61.1",
    "@tailwindcss/cli": "^4.3.0",
    "@types/better-sqlite3": "^7.6.13",
    "@types/node": "^22.10.2",
    "@types/node-forge": "^1.3.14",
    "@types/react": "^18.3.18",
    "@types/react-dom": "^18.3.5",
    "baseui": "^16.1.1",
    "clsx": "^2.1.1",
    "electron": "^42.3.3",
    "electron-builder": "^26.8.1",
    "esbuild": "^0.27.7",
    "js-yaml": "^4.3.1",
    "lucide-react": "^1.17.0",
    "motion": "^12.40.0",
    "react": "^18.3.1",
    "react-dom": "^18.3.1",
    "recharts": "^3.8.1",
    "styletron-engine-atomic": "^1.6.2",
    "styletron-react": "^6.1.1",
    "tailwind-merge": "^3.6.0",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.3.0",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "@types/react": "$@types/react",
    "fast-uri@3.1.2": "3.1.5",
    "find-my-way@9.6.0": "9.7.0",
    "js-yaml": "$js-yaml",
    "minimatch@10.2.5": {
      "brace-expansion": "5.0.9"
    },
    "pm2": {
      "js-yaml": "4.3.1"
    },
    "socks": {
      "ip-address": "10.5.0"
    }
  }
}
